---
title: "Flags of the World"
format: html
---

<style>
.flag-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr));
  gap: 1rem;
}

.flag-grid figure {
  margin: 0;
  text-align: center;
}

.flag-grid img {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}
</style>

```{r}
#| results: asis
flags <- sort(list.files(pattern = "^[a-z]{2}\\.png$"))

cat('<div class="flag-grid">')
for (flag in flags) {
  code <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(flag)
  cat(sprintf(
    '<figure><img src="%s" alt="Flag of %s"><figcaption>%s</figcaption></figure>',
    flag, toupper(code), toupper(code)
  ))
}
cat('</div>')
```
